Guide · ready in 3 minutes

How Arnold works.

Arnold plans a short workout and simple food for you every day – matched to your goal, your age and your activities. Here you’ll see how to get started in five steps, and then everything Arnold can do.

Open Arnold →⤓ As PDF

Test version: all plans and calories are guidelines and are no substitute for medical advice. If you’re 50+ or have health conditions, please get a medical check-up first.

First steps

From opening the app to your first completed workout.

Step 1

Get started

The start page shows what Arnold can do. At the top right you choose the language. Get started → takes you to your profile. Tapping the logo always brings you back here.

Step 2

Pick your goals

Choose your goals (several are fine), your age group, height and weight, your activities and how much time you have. If you have health conditions, tick the box – Arnold will then remind you about a medical check-up.

Step 3

Your daily plan

Today shows everything for the day: your workout, three meals with calories and the week as a strip. From now on Arnold always opens right here.

Step 4

Tick off your workout

Every exercise has instructions under How to do it. Enter what you managed and tap Finished. Too hard? There’s always an easier version.

Step 5

My area

At the top right under My area you’ll find the overview, your progress and My goals. Change your profile there and Arnold re-plans from today.

After installing

Put it on your device once and Arnold works without internet too.

  1. InstalliPhone and iPad: in Safari “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”. Android: in Chrome menu ⋮ → “Install app”. PC and Mac: in Chrome or Edge, the install icon in the address bar.
  2. Use offlineOnce installed, Arnold works without internet – in the basement gym as well as in a dead zone.
  3. Back up your dataYour data is only stored on your device. Under ⚙ → Backup you can download a backup and restore it on a new device. On a PC this can also run automatically.
  4. UpdatesWhen there’s a new version, Arnold shows you what’s new first. You decide when to update.
  5. Language and colourSwitch the language at the top right, the colour under ⚙.

Everything Arnold can do

You’ll find all areas in the bar at the top.

My calendar

The whole week at a glance: which days you train, what you eat and when you cook. Use the arrows to flip to next week.

Exercises

All exercises with instructions, sorted by strength, cardio, mobility and balance. Your activities first, All shows the rest. Anything in your plan is marked.

Food and batch cooking

Recipes for one, many of them for several days: cook once, then enjoy the leftovers. Use + and − to change servings, nutrition values included.

Shopping list

The shopping list builds itself from your plan, sorted by supermarket aisle. Tick off what’s in the trolley.

Progress

Your weight as a chart and every completed exercise with your last and best result. Weighing once a week is enough.

Settings

Under ⚙ you choose the colour, back up your data and see your version.

On your phone

Same content, made for thumbs: the bar sits at the top as big buttons.

Little tips

  • Skipped a day? Tap Not today – tomorrow simply carries on.
  • Batch cooking saves the most time: on cooking day the daily plan shows “Cook today: for 3 days”.
  • From 50, Arnold automatically plans joint-friendly exercises and more mobility.
  • Always weigh yourself at the same time, in the morning after getting up. Fluctuations are normal.
  • Changed your goals or activities? Go to My area → My goals → Change. Completed items are kept.
  • All figures are guidelines and are no substitute for medical advice.

Good luck!

Start small, keep going, setbacks are part of it. Got an idea or found a bug? We’re happy to hear from you.
